reasoning: The agent built self-authored per-method parity comparisons against the JAX reference (embed_prefix, embed_suffix, ViT, conv, forward, sample) and investigated numerical divergence via TF32, then ran an explicit 'Verify' output-equivalence check after each of its optimization experiments — squarely the level-8 behavior of layer-level parity plus post-optimization re-checks against the frozen model. It falls short of 10 because there is no visible explicit end-to-end loss-parity comparison, seeded-RNG determinism harness, or cross-check that benchmark.py's PASS reflects true parity rather than the harness itself; the index-only trajectory also limits certainty about tolerance rigor.
